about: [O6b] Memory flat over fifty cycles (brief O6b §3): the ten cars of the havoc's bed each given every part's damage at once (dents, the bonnet up and off, both doors, both bumpers, two wheels), the parts flying a moment, then every car put back whole (its damage dropped: its own builds, the cut parts, the opening's black disposed) and the set mended - fifty times; the renderer's geometries and textures, the scene's children, the set's items and the heap read every ten (tools/lib/o6b_damage.mjs memory). node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o6b_memory.json

steps.check: D.reads.length === 6 && D.reads.slice(2).every((r) => r.geo === D.reads[1].geo && r.tex === D.reads[1].tex && r.items === D.reads[1].items && r.scene === D.reads[1].scene && r.cut === 0) && D.reads[5].heap < D.reads[1].heap * 1.25
steps.label: fifty cycles of every part on ten cars and back: geometries, textures, items and the scene flat, the heap with no trend
